senses.gloss: m. (denom. of עִור II) inhabitant of a country town, provincial.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50:12">Gen. R. s. 50</cite>, end <he>אחד ע׳ ואחד בן המדינה</he> one from a country town and another from a capital.
Y. Ned. VII, end, 40ᶜ נראין … בע׳ R. Meïr’s opinion seems acceptable in the case of a provincial (who uses בַּיִת in the sense of the lower rooms, contrad. to עליה).

Lev. R. s. 4 משל לע׳ שהיה נשוי וכ׳ like a provincial (commoner) that married a princess; Yalk. Prov. 963 לעירני; a. e.—Pl. עִירוֹנִין, עִירָ׳. Y. Snh. V, 22ᵈ bot. הע׳ הללו those provincials (who do not know the exact date).—Fem. עִירוֹנִית.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:3">Lam. R. to IV, 2</cite> <he>ירושלמי שנשא ע׳</he> when a Jerusalemite married a provincial woman.—Pl. <he>עִירוֹנִיּוֹת</he>, <cite ref="P01269"><he>עִירָ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 80a:1">Sabb. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>בע׳</he> in the case of provincial women (who may paint both eyes without being indecent).—[<cite ref="Beitzah 32a">Bets. 32ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00695"><he>עִירָנִית</he> I</cite>.]
